notes: Sits alongside the eligibility.satisfied/outstanding tracking: an optional verification stays fully VISIBLE (satisfied/outstanding, badges, receipts) even while it is non-gating — the rule forbids it from blocking admission, not from being disclosed.

canaries.assertion: Re-adding `args.pulseAuthorized && args.pnlEnabled` to buildFinancialServicesMembership's fullyEligible condition flips the 'reports Service Ready even with Pulse/P&L outstanding' test's lifecycleState assertion from 'service-ready' back to 'in-admission', failing the canary.

statement: A verification or capability explicitly designated optional must never be folded into the boolean that decides an admission/eligibility status — it may be tracked and disclosed, but the gate must be satisfiable without it.

occurrences.defect: Pulse/P&L (the journey's optional `verify` stage) were ANDed into `fullyEligible`, the boolean that produces Service Ready — an already-ratified 'optional, never gating' rule (2026-08-05 Agent Bench design §5/§7; task #13) was reintroduced by a single boolean expression despite being explicitly named as a risk to avoid in the same design doc.
